svg.title: Tala Pulse — TanawOrbit team cover
svg.desc: Original SI-generated Filipino team cover artwork. Large Tala Pulse typography sits beside an abstract wireframe planet, an orbital path, and an illustrative pulse line. Tala means star in Filipino. Tagline: Human health. Beyond Earth. Project: TanawOrbit. Not a photograph, clinical measurement, NASA insignia, or NASA mission identifier.
